environment: managed Linux preview, cloud browser, temporary memory, WebGL 2 unavailable, Ollama unavailable
measurement: source batch release -> committed React update -> two animation frames -> server receives browser acknowledgement (conservative upper bound, not GPU completion)
interpretation: All acknowledged batches were below five seconds, but three batches lack browser acknowledgements. This trial does not establish the all-update <=5-second criterion. Rerun a bounded trial on the final Mac with the selected storage and loaded 3D scene. Percentiles describe acknowledged batches only.
